thread:
maria_g: hey team, first day! trying to enroll my company MacBook Air (macOS 14.4) into MDM and it gets "Failed to contact server" during enrollment. wifi is my home network. anyone seen this? :confused:
it_helpdesk: welcome @maria_g :tada: are you on a consumer ISP with known DNS filtering? also, did you try the onboarding Wi‑Fi profile we emailed? sometimes corp certs need the SSID to be trusted.
maria_g: i'm on my apartment wifi, no captive portal. i tried the emailed wifi profile and it connected fine. same error at the final enrollment step.
dev_env_bot: quick checklist: 1) ensure date/time set to automatic 2) disable firewall for testing 3) try a phone hotspot 4) share console logs: `log show --predicate 'process == "profilesd"' --last 1h`
marie: oops typo — meant maria_g above.
it_helpdesk: @maria_g please paste the last 50 lines of profilesd logs and also `sw_vers -productVersion`. we'll also check the MDM service health.
maria_g: sw_vers: 14.4
profilesd log excerpt:
```
profilesd: enrollment: contacting https://mdm.redwood-internal.corp/enroll
profilesd: TLS handshake failed: certificate unknown
profilesd: enrollment: server returned 500
```
it_helpdesk: TLS certificate unknown suggests a trust chain problem. do you have our internal root cert installed in the System keychain? run `security find-certificate -a -c "Redwood Internal CA"`
maria_g: that returns nothing. i didn't get any certs in the onboarding email except the wifi profile.

tony_ops: we recently pushed a new root cert for MDM. onboarding email should have included an installer pkg. @it_helpdesk can you re-send the cert and a .pkg for system install? new hires on macOS Sonoma sometimes need the root in System rather than login keychain.
it_helpdesk: resending package to maria_g via secure link. steps: 1) install the root certificate to System keychain (you'll need admin creds) 2) reboot 3) retry enrollment. if you don't have admin, we can temporarily grant local admin for 2 hours.
maria_g: i don't have admin yet. can i get temporary admin? i need to install Homebrew and Docker for the dev setup too.
it_helpdesk: temporary admin approved for 2 hours. email with sudo token sent. once you finish installing, request removal in this thread.

maria_g: installed cert and rebooted. enrollment now proceeds further but asks to approve a management profile at System Preferences -> Profiles. when i click approve it asks for a consent code.
it_helpdesk: that consent code is emailed from IT during onboarding — but if it's missing we can generate one-time approval. @tony_ops can you create OOB approval code for serial: C02Q3NLV1234?
tony_ops: generated code: QR7-9H2-FM1. posted via secure DM.
maria_g: approved and enrollment completed. FileVault is showing 'pending enablement'. will it prompt on next login?
it_helpdesk: FileVault should prompt after we escrow the key. i see your device in the console as 'pending fv enable'. i'm pushing the enable command now. dev_env_bot: action: push/filevault-enable -> target serial C02Q3NLV1234 status queued

it_helpdesk: pushed. you'll get a prompt on next logout/login to enable FileVault; we'll escrow the recovery key to KMS.
maria_g: prompt appeared and i'm enabling. also, about local admin — can i keep it to run brew + docker?
lina_pd: for dev access we try to avoid persistent admin. request a 7‑day temporary admin and then remove it. we have scripts for installing Docker without admin using Apple virtualization sometimes but it's more reliable with sudo.
it_helpdesk: granted 7-day admin window. please run the bootstrap script we provided (link in onboarding DM) to set up brew, asdf, and Docker. after 7 days we'll automatically revoke. if you hit permission errors post-revoke open a ticket and we'll reprovision minimal helpers.
maria_g: bootstrap finished, docker runs, fdesetup status shows "FileVault On." thank you all! what's the best channel for follow-ups on apps that need additional entitlements?
it_helpdesk: ping #it-help for entitlement requests and #dev-env for environment issues. we'll add you to the new-hires checklist board as well.
maria_g: perfect — appreciate the quick responses. see you in onboarding sync later. :smile:
